purpose: Teach: かから/そうして/背筋/座ら/変えれ/ぼろ/ふら/きょう

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お金かからないお店、知ってる?
lines.en: Hey Riku — you know any cheap places to eat?
lines.style: Direct, casual opening. Natural rhythm of a friend asking a favour. Slight lift at the end like she's genuinely curious about what he knows.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、そうして部活を始めたんだろ?桜
lines.en: So that's how you ended up joining the club, huh? Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle redirect. Testing her answer, but not hostile. Observant tone — he's noticed something. Steady gaze, warm undercurrent.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の背筋、漫画みたいだぜ
lines.en: Your posture is insane, Riku — like straight out of a manga.
lines.style: Quick, genuine praise. Light and teasing on the surface. Slight warmth underneath — she means it. No performance, just honest observation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ずっと座らないで応援してたな、桜
lines.en: You were standing the whole time cheering, weren't you? That's so you.
lines.style: Soft realisation in the voice. Not sentimental, but noticing something she hadn't meant to say out loud. Slight trailing-off. Affectionate despite herself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、髪型を変えればモテるかもよ
lines.en: If you changed up your hair, you'd probably get more attention, you know?
lines.style: Teasing but with teeth — delivered fast, testing his reaction. The kind of thing she'd say to see if it lands. Slight smirk in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のリュック、ぼろぼろじゃん、桜
lines.en: Your backpack is literally falling apart, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry observation, not mean. Matter-of-fact delivery. Small beat after her name — he's not lecturing, just noticing. Light concern wrapped in casual tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ふらふらしてないか?
lines.en: You're not feeling dizzy or anything, are you?
lines.style: Careful softness. The question behind the question — actual worry. Quiet, steady. Checking in without making a big deal of it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、きょうの宿題終わったか?桜
lines.en: Did you finish today's homework yet, Sakura?
lines.style: Familiar check-in rhythm. Warm and close — the kind of question asked by someone comfortable enough to care. Light, no pressure. Like they've asked this a hundred times.
